about.title: About GreenBird
about.subtitle: Where athletic engineering meets modern luxury
about.body: GreenBird was founded to be the premier destination for performance athletic footwear. Every silhouette is curated for superior materials, outsole grip, and responsive cushioning—on the court or in the city.
about.vision_desc: To be the leading luxury athletic footwear destination, uniting technical innovation with an effortless digital shopping experience.
about.mission_desc: Empowering athletes and sneaker enthusiasts with authentic, high-performance footwear backed by exceptional care.
about.val1_desc: Every pair undergoes strict inspection for materials, stitching, and durability.
about.val2_desc: Focused on impact protection, breathability, and responsive energy return.
about.val3_desc: Bold colorways and clean lines that stand out on and off the court.
about.val4_desc: Flexible size exchanges and continuous support long after delivery.
about.m1_desc: GreenBird debuted with a curated lineup of pro basketball footwear.
about.m2_desc: Added running, training, and lifestyle collections with 25,000+ orders.
about.m3_desc: Launched our luxury interactive Salla storefront experience.

contact.faq1_a: Orders are dispatched within hours and arrive in 24–48 hours in major cities, or 2–4 days elsewhere.
contact.faq2_q: How do I pick the right EU size?
contact.faq2_a: All our sneakers follow true-to-size EU standards. If you are between sizes for basketball shoes, we recommend sizing up.
contact.faq3_q: What is your return & exchange policy?
contact.faq3_a: We offer free size exchanges and flexible returns within 14 days of delivery in original unworn condition.
contact.faq4_q: Are payments on the store secure?
contact.faq4_a: Yes, all transactions are encrypted via Salla's certified gateways supporting Mada, Visa, Mastercard, and Apple Pay.
